en-US: FAT32 and exFAT store times with 2-second precision: with this margin identical files are not copied again.

en-US: Create them from a transfer's Options tab ("Save as task"); the Windows Task Scheduler runs them, even when MegaCopier is closed.

en-US: Each new folder is copied hidden and only appears under its name when everything went well: there is never a half-copied folder that looks complete.

es-ES: Si el origen tiene sectores dañados, se lee sector a sector y se salva todo lo legible; lo ilegible queda en ceros y se anota en el registro. El original no se borra al mover.
en-US: If the source has bad sectors, it is read sector by sector and everything readable is saved; unreadable parts become zeros and are logged. The original is not deleted when moving.

en-US: Partly rescued: some source sectors were damaged and became zeros (details in the Log).
